name: lucas-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Lucas Saldanha Werneck: verification guards, session tools, research, web and desktop helpers.

plugins.name: handoff-terminal
plugins.description: When the Claude desktop app refuses a sign-in or personal-data step in the browser, a hidden terminal session does it and hands the result back.

plugins.name: op-secrets
plugins.description: Save and load secrets through 1Password without the values ever entering the chat.

plugins.name: assumptions-pane
plugins.description: A side pane where Claude logs every assumption it makes, so you can confirm or correct it with a click.

plugins.name: save-clear
plugins.description: Save decisions and next steps to a snapshot, clear the session, and resume from the snapshot in the next one.

plugins.name: give-up-guard
plugins.description: Stop hook: when Claude ends with 'I didn't check X', hands the task back or asks you for data, it is sent back to check first.

plugins.name: wait-loop-guard
plugins.description: Blocks Bash wait loops (until/while) that have no deadline, so Claude can't hang forever.

plugins.name: web-unlock-guard
plugins.description: Guards web scraping: stop retrying a failing method, no headless browser on Cloudflare pages, no debug port without a separate profile.

plugins.name: self-improve
plugins.description: Finds where you corrected Claude more than once and proposes the fix in CLAUDE.md, skills or memory; small fixes apply alone, the rest wait for your OK.

plugins.name: idea-shelf
plugins.description: A side shelf for ideas that come up mid-task: jot them down without sidetracking Claude, then send the list in one click.

plugins.name: polish
plugins.description: A simplicity review in the style of Linear or Apple Notes: lists every change with its gain and risk, and changes nothing until you pick.

plugins.name: llm-council
plugins.description: Ask several LLMs from different vendors through OpenRouter; they answer, rank each other anonymously, and a chairman model writes the final answer. Also cross-review: the same plan to the council and to Codex in parallel.

plugins.name: mac-remote
plugins.description: Lets Claude see and control your Mac through Screen Sharing, even with the screen locked: unlock, screenshot, click, type, lock again. Can also restart a FileVault Mac without stopping at the disk password.

plugins.name: rc-auto
plugins.description: Turns Remote Control on for a desktop-app session when you type in it, and off again after 24 hours without a message from you.

plugins.name: session-keeper
plugins.description: Restart your Mac, iTerm2 or a single Claude Code session without losing windows or conversations: snapshot, then reopen and resume.

plugins.name: remote-sessions
plugins.description: From the phone (Remote Control): open or resume a Claude Code session in another project folder in a new terminal window, or fork the current one.

plugins.name: session-archive
plugins.description: Archives your Claude Code conversations (a readable digest plus the gzipped transcript) before Claude Code deletes old ones.

plugins.name: launchd-agenda
plugins.description: Schedule Claude Code sessions on your Mac with launchd, so they run locally with your skills and hooks.

plugins.name: web-unlock
plugins.description: A skill for when a normal web fetch is blocked: ladders by site type, a per-site registry of what worked, and a search doctrine. Pairs with web-unlock-guard.
